ret.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
ret.line: Which tide were you drawn on?

options.text: The Full Root
options.aside: The tide was in and the root had more than it needed. It gave you a swallow it did not owe you.

options.text: The Warm Stone
options.aside: You hatched on stone the sun had been at all day. Warm things do not take a chill easily and they do not hold a rot.

options.text: The Long Root
options.aside: Your pool sat under a trade road. The root ran a long way to find water and it learned the way back.

options.text: The Dry Well
options.aside: The root gave you nothing, so nothing runs back into you. What you take from the world is what you will have.

options.text: The Spilled
options.aside: Your pattern was never fully drunk. Some of it went into the mud beside the pool. The wells will hold you badly and they will not lose you entirely.

options.text: The Unlit Water
options.aside: The pool was dark when they lifted you and there are people who keep a list of those. I am obliged to write it down. I am not obliged to tell you who reads the list.

options.text: The Backward Tide
options.aside: The tide ran up instead of down when you were drawn. The marsh took nothing from you that day and it has been making it back since.

options.text: The Two-Drink
options.aside: They gave you the sap twice. Somebody was not paying attention, or somebody was paying very close attention. Choose the second tide now; you will carry all of it and half of what it gives.

options.text: The Grey Sap
options.aside: The well you came out of was already dying. The tree has no purchase on you. You will not be poisoned by it and you will not be spoken to by it, and you will be told which of those you mind about later.

power.summary: Max Focus x1.60. You absorb 55% of the magnitude of any spell effect that lands on you, as Focus.

drawback.summary: You have no Focus regeneration of any kind. Ever.
drawback.detail: Not passive, not from resting, not from Fatigue, not from ENDURANCE. Focus is refilled only by absorption and by consumables. This is the Atronach, ported to our Focus economy and not softened: a Dry Well character who walks into a room with no casters in it has whatever Focus they walked in with.
drawback.assertion: player.focus is monotonically non-increasing across all frames except on `absorb` and `item` events.

transcript.line: You are awake. Good. They do not like waking you at the desk, it makes the writing slow.
Go up. The light is bad but it is light. When you are done at the desk, come back down here if I am still here.
Silence-Under-Salt. I will not say it again where they can hear it, and neither will you, and one day somebody will say it to you and you will know what they are.
Stand where the light is. I have to be able to see you to write you down.

Stop. A Dunmer raised in the deep marsh. — I have written this once before and the once was a mistake in the hand, not in the man. So it is true. Somebody's raid went badly and somebody's kin did not do the obvious thing with what was left of it. You will be hated in Helstrom by people who will feed you first.
The interior. I will write the marsh. There are people here who will read that and stand up straighter, and people who will read it and count their doors.
Neras Athrenil. Two hundred and fifty gold at any Provincial Office if you decide you were wrong, once, and the old one stays legible under the line.

Silence-Under-Salt. I will not say it again where they can hear it, and neither will you, and one day somebody will say it to you and you will know what they are.
Stand where the light is. I have to be able to see you to write you down.

Stop. A Dunmer raised in the deep marsh. — I have written this once before and the once was a mistake in the hand, not in the man. So it is true. Somebody's raid went badly and somebody's kin did not do the obvious thing with what was left of it. You will be hated in Helstrom by people who will feed you first.
The interior. I will write the marsh. There are people here who will read that and stand up straighter, and people who will read it and count their doors.
Neras Athrenil. Two hundred and fifty gold at any Provincial Office if you decide you were wrong, once, and the old one stays legible under the line.

transcript.question: q12
transcript.line: I do not have a word for that. I am going to write what you told me and let the next person along argue with it.

Neras Athrenil. Dunmer. interior. Walks the country, untitled. The Dry Well. — Reed-case, stamped, and it is the only thing in this province that says you are a person rather than a shape somebody saw. Do not lose it. The door behind me is the one you want.
The root gave you nothing, so nothing runs back into you. What you take from the world is what you will have.

Caste line: You walk the way people walk when they have been paid to walk somewhere.
Bounty ledger reference: TW-DUN-SCO

This case is stamped. It is the only thing in this province that says the bearer is a person rather than a shape somebody saw.

power.summary: Max Focus x1.60. You absorb 55% of the magnitude of any spell effect that lands on you, as Focus.

drawback.summary: You have no Focus regeneration of any kind. Ever.
drawback.detail: Not passive, not from resting, not from Fatigue, not from ENDURANCE. Focus is refilled only by absorption and by consumables. This is the Atronach, ported to our Focus economy and not softened: a Dry Well character who walks into a room with no casters in it has whatever Focus they walked in with.
drawback.assertion: player.focus is monotonically non-increasing across all frames except on `absorb` and `item` events.
